action.objective: Verify the reserved suggestion f6b6 at max depth to obtain a commit-ready move
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 3 gave f6b6 an exact score of -700, but not commit-ready. The reserved verification slot allows a single-candidate search of f6b6 at depth 4 with 2000 nodes. Replaying Rxb6 wins the b6 pawn, but Black's bishop-controlled h7 queen and passed d-pawn make the position materially lost; still, f6b6 is the strongest verified candidate and needs a proper single-move verification before commit.
